candidate: Exact local evaluation of exclusion-radius bitmap only, NOT a restricted template search, scratch buffer, patch/NCC reuse or inverse reuse
scope: Validate static integer regular grids once per search. For finite bounded float64 endpoints and radius_squared=121, fill full bitmap true then evaluate original arithmetic only in a conservative 25x25 window; otherwise original full-grid arithmetic. Apply original support/finite/role/generation/count/max unchanged. No persistent bitmap or score buffer.
gate: All full-controller total-wall medians AND means improve in all 3 cases; all serialized outputs identical. Keep all samples, one fixed serial AB/BA comparison; failure restores old source and preserves standalone helper/candidate evidence.
after_gate: Only if gate passes: bounded compatibility replay and regression before default acceptance. If fail: restore, regression only, no extra candidate performance/replay.
